title: Second moment of the free-coordinate count
statement:
Fix $n \in \bbn$, a parameter $p \in \bbr$, and a set of coordinates $U \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$. For a restriction $\rho$ on $n$ variables write $J(\rho)$ for its set of free variables. Summing over all such restrictions, each weighted by its Bernoulli weight, one has
\[
  \sum_{\rho} p^{\abs{J(\rho)}}\left(\tfrac{1-p}{2}\right)^{\,n - \abs{J(\rho)}} \abs{U \cap J(\rho)}^2
  \;=\; p\,\abs{U} + p^2\bigl(\abs{U}^2 - \abs{U}\bigr).
\]
hypotheses_covered: parameter p is a real number
U is a subset of Fin n
sum ranges over all restrictions on n variables
each term weighted by the Bernoulli restriction weight
replaced:
Under a Bernoulli($p$)-random restriction with free set $J$, for every set $U$,
\[
  \E\bigl[\abs{U \cap J}^2\bigr] \;=\; p \cdot \abs{U} \;+\; p^2\bigl(\abs{U}^2 - \abs{U}\bigr).
\]
